headline: BOC commissions Teesside carbon capture facility to strengthen UK CO2 supply
summary: Industrial-gases firm BOC (part of Linde) reports commissioning a carbon capture facility at Teesside that recovers CO2 to shore up Britain's domestic merchant/food-grade CO2 supply, which has suffered periodic shortages.
co2crc_note: A merchant-CO2 capture plant (supply security) rather than CCS-for-storage; marginal for CO2CRC beyond showing capture tech reaching commercial industrial-gas operations.

headline: TotalEnergies completes new surveys of its North Sea CO2 storage sites
summary: TotalEnergies reports completing new surveys (site-characterisation work) across its Danish North Sea CO2 storage acreage, advancing appraisal of saline-aquifer and depleted-field storage options it operates with partners.
co2crc_note: Offshore storage-site characterisation and survey practice is directly relevant to CO2CRC's storage-appraisal and MMV expertise and to Australia's offshore storage programme.

headline: CO2CRC's Otway International Test Centre featured on the world stage at GHGT-18 in Perth
summary: CO2CRC's Otway International Test Centre took a prominent role at GHGT-18 (Perth, 25-29 Oct), showcasing its long-running storage, monitoring and verification (MMV) field research to the sector's flagship global scientific meeting.
co2crc_note: CO2CRC's own flagship field laboratory profiled at the conference CO2CRC co-hosts — direct reputational and scientific relevance.
